journey.name: Layout and Readability Journey
journey.description: Verify title readability in compact mode, stabilized image scrolling, and image placement toggles

actions.action: Verify that feed items display thumbnail images and article titles wrap across multiple lines
Verify that by default, thumbnails appear on the left side of the title
Enable the "Place image on right" switch
Verify that in the widget, thumbnail images are positioned on the right side of the text block
Open widget settings and disable "Compact mode"
Verify that standard layout feed articles display images with fixed height constraints (160dp)
Scroll down through the feed items and scroll back up
Verify that scrolling is smooth and no jumping or skipping occurs
